subject: SIG: Breach notification Q&A — evidence, contacts & timing
messages:

Subject: SIG questionnaire — incident response & breach notification follow ups

Hi Priya,

Thanks for returning the SIG questionnaire last week. Our InfoSec team has a couple of focused follow-ups around incident response and breach notification that we need resolved before we mark the security review complete.

Specifically:
- Notification windows: the SIG asks for "maximum notification time to customers/governance after detection/confirmation" — can you confirm Redwood's standard timelines and if there are different tiers by data sensitivity?
- Incident contacts: please provide the primary and escalation contacts for incident response, including phone or pager for 24/7 incidents (if available).
- Evidence: we need an item we can upload to our review portal showing the notification process exists (playbook extract, redacted incident timeline template, or SOC 2 evidence referencing IR).

I've attached the SIG_v2_questionnaire.xlsx with the specific cell references we flagged. If useful, a short matrix (who, when, what to customers/regulators) would help speed this along.

Can you get back to us today or tomorrow? GreenBank is hoping to close the vendor review by end of week.

Best,
Alice
Alice Monroe
Sr. Vendor Risk Analyst — GreenBank Financial

Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — incident response & breach notification follow ups

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. See answers inline below and attached a redacted IR roster and an initial notification matrix for your intake portal.

On notification windows:
- Detection -> Triage: internal detection acknowledged within 1 hour during business hours; extended-monitoring window up to 4 hours for complex incidents.
- Confirmation -> Customer notification: standard SLA is 72 hours from confirmation for incidents involving unauthorized access to customer data where we have confirmed exposure of customer-identifying data. For lower-severity events (no confirmed data exposure), we aim for initial customer-facing communication within 7 business days with a follow-up summary if needed. We can treat specific GreenBank data classes as higher priority if required by contract.

On incident contacts:
- Primary IR lead (24/7 paging): Rishi Malhotra, Head of Reliability — rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, +1-415-555-0198 (pager/cell).
- Secondary / legal liaison (business hours): Grace O'Connor, Legal Ops — grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, +1-650-555-0142.
- Security engineering escalation: security@redwood.ai (monitored 24/7).

Evidence we can provide:
- Attached: ir_roster_redacted.pdf (lists roles, escalation phones, and planner template)
- We can also provide a redacted incident timeline template and a crosswalk to the SOC 2 control narrative that references our notification procedure.
- If GreenBank needs an item for the portal, ir_notification_matrix.csv maps event type -> notification window -> recipient sets.

Next steps: please confirm which of the three evidence items you prefer to upload (roster, timeline template, or SOC 2 crosswalk). If you want the SOC 2 artifact, I can loop in our compliance lead to provide the relevant control ID and test evidence.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai | +1-415-555-0112

Adding a couple of clarifications from engineering/ops:
- For high-confidence confirmed data exposures we commit to an initial outbound notification within 72 hours of confirmation; our detection-to-confirmation time varies by signal — we log detection timestamps and can provide redacted samples from past incidents for timeline proof.
- We maintain a 24/7 on-call rotation for severity-1 incidents; the paged engineer is responsible for triage within 30 minutes and for activating the IR roster.
- We do not publish customer emails/phone numbers as part of our public artifacts; if GreenBank needs proof of customer notification we can provide redacted notices and proof of delivery metadata under an NDA/DSA.

If you want, I can export a redacted incident timeline sample and a single example of a customer notification we sent (with PII removed) — will coordinate with legal for approvals.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra

Thanks — this is helpful. A few follow-ups:
1) For the 72-hour SLA: does that include weekends/holidays? GreenBank's policy requires calendar-day counting for regulator notifications.
2) Can you confirm whether Redwood's legal review is required before customer notification, or if ops can send an initial alert then hand off to legal for regulator-facing statements?
3) For the evidence upload: we'll accept either the redacted incident timeline sample or a SOC 2 crosswalk. Timeline sample preferred.

If you can provide the redacted sample and a short note on the calendar-day interpretation, we can close this thread and mark the SIG question as satisfied.

Regards,
Alice

Alice — quick consolidation and next steps (forwarding the redacted timeline sample as requested).

- Calendar days: our 72-hour notification SLA is measured in calendar hours (i.e., includes weekends/holidays). If a contract requires regulator-specific timing (e.g., 72 hours for GDPR-like obligations), we will comply per contractual terms and can add explicit language to the agreement.
- Legal involvement: ops may issue an initial customer-facing alert for confirmed exposures (aim: timely transparency). Legal/Privacy is then engaged in parallel for regulator communications and any required filings; we will not make regulator filings without Legal sign-off.
- Evidence delivered: attached ir_notification_matrix.csv and a redacted incident timeline sample. The timeline is scrubbed of PII and incident identifiers and includes timestamps for detection, confirmation, customer notification, and remediation milestones.

Please confirm if GreenBank needs the SOC 2 control mapping instead — Grace, can you follow up with the compliance artifact if requested?
